Specification of Platform Health Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
Scope of Global Supervision: Global Supervision corresponds to whole or part of a
Function Group
. A Global Supervision can contain all or a certain set of Elementary
Supervisions corresponding to processes controlled within a single Function Group
context. The mapping from Supervisions to Global Supervision is flexible. Through
configuration, user can decide which Supervisions belong to which Global Supervision.
But there are following restrictions:
•
all Supervisions comprising a Global Supervision are corresponding to processes
controlled within a single Function Group context and
•
a Supervision can be part of only one Global Supervision.
